payload.title: Edit-Rerun Handler + Full G7 Env Audit (ZERO-CREDS All 4 Sub-Gates)
ac_list: AC-1: Edit-rerun handler fully wired in dashboard (4-step UI: edit JSON → run sandbox → paste output → apply results)
AC-2: Env audit empty (env | grep -iE TELEGRAM|BOT_TOKEN|CHAT_ID|TOKEN|SECRET|API_KEY|PASSWORD returns empty)
AC-3: Sandbox source grep zero (grep -rniE token|chat_id|bot|secret|api_key|password apps/alert-engine/cmd/sandbox/ returns 0)
AC-4: Sandbox all-green end-to-end (CGO_ENABLED=0 go run ./cmd/sandbox -tier=all -module=alert-engine -scenario=all exits 0; total=11 pass=11 fail=0)
AC-5: R-1 determinism inherited (grep -rn math/rand|time.Now|uuid|rand. returns 0 or only pre-existing allowed entries)
AC-7: Edit→rerun cycle proven (QA edits scenario JSON, reruns sandbox, pastes output, dashboard applies + updates cards)
hard_gates: G7 ZERO-CREDS all-4 sub-gates (AC-2 env audit + AC-3 scenario grep + AC-4 CGO build + AC-7 edit→rerun cycle)
G12 DoD: sandbox all-green BEFORE RETURN block (AC-4)
L84 explicit staging: git add <explicit-path> ONLY, never -A or .
